ignōtus

ignōtus, ignōta, ignōtum

adjective, declension

unknown, unfamiliar, strange

In this lexicon

  • strange

    the recommended word · classical · Ter. Ph. 548: in ignōtum hinc abdūcet locum; Liv. 28.44.3: major ignōtārum rērum est terror

Examples
